name: web-lilac-online-course-dashboard-with-hero-banner-and-mentor-list
title: Lilac Online Course Dashboard
whatItIs: A white app window on grey with a sidebar, a search and profile header, a violet hero banner with sparkles and a Join Now button, three course progress cards, Continue Watching photo cards with tags and progress bars, a lesson table, and a right column with a statistic ring around a memoji avatar, a bar chart and a mentor list with Follow buttons.
whatItMeans: A violet hero and pastel tags make a learning dashboard friendly, and memoji avatars add personality.
techniques: Violet hero banner with sparkle shapes
Pastel category tags on course cards
Bar chart with one dark bar

vocabulary.definition: A large promotional card at the top of a dashboard.
A row of in-progress content cards.
A cartoon-style portrait used as a profile picture.
